note: G15 catalog additions (HOMESTEAD_SIM_PLAYABILITY_ROADMAP.md, session G15, item 6). Rows only: no existing number changes.

systems.name: Rain Barrel (55 gal)
systems.description: A 55-gallon barrel under a small catchment of its own: a shed roof, a tarp, or a gutter off a tent fly.
systems.notes: Water out = catchment x rainfall x 0.623 gal/sq ft-in x efficiency. Brings its own 100 sq ft catchment, so it needs no Roofing area.

systems.name: Pellet Mill (small)
systems.description: A small flat-die mill that presses dry wood chips into stove pellets.
systems.notes: About 100 lbs of pellets a week from 120 lbs of chips; the rest is moisture and fines.

systems.name: Part-Time Job (20 hrs)
systems.description: Twenty hours a week at median hourly pay, with a shorter commute.
systems.notes: Trades income for about 20 hours a week of homestead labor.

systems.name: Remote Job (40 hrs)
systems.description: A full-time job worked from home: no commute.
systems.notes: Pays a little less than the average job but needs no transportation.

systems.name: Sheet-Mulch Lawn Conversion (500 sq ft)
systems.description: Cardboard and browns laid over lawn and topped with compost; the grass rots into planting soil.
systems.notes: Builds about 40 cu ft of soil over a growing season.

systems.name: Home Weatherization Retrofit
systems.description: Air sealing, attic insulation, and weatherstripping on an existing home.
systems.notes: Cuts the host shelter's heat loss by about 30% (engine modifier, catalog_overrides.json).

flows.note: Weekly upkeep hours (Systems column K): a yearly check of seals and weatherstripping.

systems.name: Suburban Lot (1/4 acre)
systems.description: A quarter-acre suburban lot, usually bought with the house on it.
systems.notes: Lot rules (setbacks, animal limits) vary by town.

systems.name: Clothesline
systems.description: A line and two posts: sun-dried laundry instead of the electric dryer.
systems.notes: Saves about 1 kWh per person a week of dryer power (engine modifier, catalog_overrides.json).

flows.note: Weekly upkeep hours (Systems column K): hanging and folding.
